purpose: Top-level signpost for the current proof corpus.
static_evidence_note: Static-corpus scenarios (static-corpus-row-validator.js and the four row-specific readers) load PRIOR evidence as a comparison baseline via `index.static_evidence_sha || index.current_sha`. current_sha (c868194) holds live run artefacts only and carries no EVIDENCE.md, so every static-corpus row resolved a non-existent path and reported all checks false - 13 rows failed (9 x exit 99 threshold, 4 x exit 107 open() abort) for that single reason, not for product regressions. This pin names the last corpus that actually carries the static baseline in the layout the scenarios read (<row>/cael-dgx/ plus its ancillary receipts: test logs, source snippets, hop1/hop2, verifier and tempo receipts - all verified present for all 13 rows). Baseline only: it never supplies candidate verdicts, and each row's evidence records `carriedFrom` so the provenance is explicit in the published artefact rather than implied.
build_string: OpenClaw exact candidate (c868194) — continuation PR-presentation head for openclaw/openclaw#85651
disposition_note: Live execution on cael. This corpus is bound to the EXACT SHA the upstream PR presents (c868194): build-info commit on the seat was verified == candidate before capture, and the PR head equalled the presentation branch tip at capture time. The previous corpus (b27a262) was NOT transposable onto this head - it is not an ancestor of it and carried Emeric #1229 bytes the PR does not ship - so it was replaced rather than relabelled. 4 rows (R-CW-5/5A/6/6A) are orchestration-required and excluded from --live-suite by design, not dropped, so 34 is the runnable denominator. All rows are candidateOnly with foldRequiresReview: nothing here is canonical proof or an automatic fold input. 7 rows remain review-pending; their receipts are itemised in review.pendingReceiptTally. The continuation-trace-correlation and tempo-trace-json debts have a known cause: the seat has no built extensions (extensions/*/dist is empty) and diagnostics-otel is not enabled, so the openclaw.tool.execution span carrying gen_ai.tool.name is never exported. Core continuation.* spans DO reach Tempo, which is why traces match but lack the originating tool span. That is a seat observability gap, not a product defect, and it is stated here rather than papered over.
